articles.text: Thredd Joins The Visa Agentic Ready Programme, Bringing Agent Network Readiness To Issuers Across Europe, Starting With Zilch. LONDON, July 15, 2026--Thredd, the AI-first issuer processing platform, today announced it has joined the Visa Agentic Ready programme, enabling issuers across Europe to participate in agent-initiated payments without rebuilding their payments infrastructure. Consumer payments platform Zilch will be among the first issuers on the platform to enable agent-initiated payments for its cardholders.
articles.headline: Thredd Joins The Visa Agentic Ready Programme, Bringing Agent Network Readiness To Issuers Across Europe, Starting With Zilch
articles.summary: LONDON, July 15, 2026--Thredd, the AI-first issuer processing platform, today announced it has joined the Visa Agentic Ready programme, enabling issuers across Europe to participate in agent-initiated payments without rebuilding their payments infrastructure. Consumer payments platform Zilch will be among the first issuers on the platform to enable agent-initiated payments for its cardholders.

articles.text: HY10 Selected Among the First Participants for Visa’s Infinite Private Program. articles.text: Ripple Is Now a Premier Member of the x402 Foundation, Alongside Visa and Mastercard. AI agents are about to start spending money on their own, and whoever owns the rails they pay on owns a brand-new market. Ripple just took a seat at the table where those rules are being written, alongside Visa, Mastercard, and Google.
